home.title: Free the Tools – everyday tools that never leave your device
home.description: Free, open-source tools for PDFs, images, text and more, right in your browser. Your files stay on your device. No accounts, no ads.
home.schemaDescription: Free, open-source tools that run in your browser. Your files stay on your device.
home.findLabel: What do you need to do?
home.findPlaceholder: What do you need to do?
home.aiText: Claude, Cursor and other assistants can run these tools on your own computer, free and with no login, so your files are never uploaded. It is on npm and in the official MCP Registry.
home.why3: They should *not* put your files at risk.
home.why4: They should *not* be hard to find.
home.whyEnd: So here they are: one place, every tool, {mark}

suggest.title: Suggest a tool
suggest.hint1: For example: join two PDFs, or shrink a photo. At least 10 characters.
suggest.useHint: Optional. A program, a website or a workaround.
suggest.emailLabel: Your email, if you want a reply
suggest.emailHint: Optional. We use it only to answer you.
suggest.sooner: Sponsoring a tool helps it get built sooner. Every little bit helps. You do not have to: your suggestion is welcome either way.
suggest.privacy: Your suggestion is emailed to the maintainers only when you press Send suggestion. Nothing is stored.
